label: GO step after two consecutive rewards, early-to-mid episode (trials < 30)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never D1/D2) and only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 has 100% recall). Precision is improved by requiring the trial before that also rewarded (reward streak), and by a strong episode-time dependence: active on ~11-13% of steps in trials 3-29, falling sharply after trial 30 and silent after trial ~55 and on trials 0-2. Episode time is not a task input, so the unit presumably reads an internal slow drift of the hidden state. In examples activation ramps up over consecutive rewarded GO steps within a window. Not modulated by choice (a1/a2 equal), state, good state, or the upcoming reward; slightly lower after rare transitions. Dev: P 0.69, R 0.84, F1 0.76, mass recall 0.91. All variables are observed (ep_trial is not a future variable).
